learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to read and understand easy texts (Reading).
They will be able to write letters with simple sentences, introduce themselves and others (Writing).
They will be able to listen to and understand basic daily conversations; introduce and express themselves and others with simple sentences (Listening and Speaking).
They will be able to recognize and use basic vocabulary related to daily life (Vocabulary).
Technology Use: They will acquire independent study skills by completing internet assignments given through technology and will be able to access all course materials via Moodle.

syllabus_topics: Developing skills to express oneself with appropriate time structures, especially to articulate daily needs.
Reinforcing learned structures with simple reading texts and listening activities.
